name: Manfu Futou Dai 5 Wa
source:
Sun C* started going out with the teacher who has been kind to her.
Guan Y* started loving a man deeply due to the hypnosis.

Two women went to a tropical island, led by their men.

孫○開始與一直溫柔對待她的老師交往。
關○則因為催眠，深深愛上了一個男人。

兩個女人在各自男人的帶領下，來到了一座熱帶島嶼。
